issues.description: The problem statement's UML marks acceptSupplyDelivery as a public method of SealSaloon (shown with '+'), implying it should be publicly accessible. In the provided solution SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery is declared static but with package-private visibility (no access modifier). This mismatch can confuse students about the intended visibility and may cause tests or example usage that expect a public method to fail or differ from the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make acceptSupplyDelivery explicitly public and static in SealSaloon (declare as public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(...)) so its visibility matches the UML/problem statement and example usage. Update any references if needed. This preserves the shared/static behavior while matching the specified public API.
